a.actualPrompt: Use case: product-mockup. Landscape 4:3, sharp realistic studio photograph for a family spot-the-difference game. Objects fully framed with ample margins, soft even illumination, clean simple composition. No words, labels, numerals, logos, watermark, collage, people, extra objects or decorative patterns. Close still-life of neatly folded ivory shirt cuff resting on plain light gray surface, no person. One silver square cufflink in center-right cuff has a small BLUE square inset, inset centered x=68 y=55, side 7 percent image width. Plain dark gray necktie loosely folded far left. Fine sharp fabric texture. This is the first image of a matched pair. All objects stable, stationary and easy to compare.

b.actualPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the EXACT first image of a spot-the-difference pair. Make ONE AND ONLY ONE intentional change: Recolor only the small BLUE square inset of the silver cufflink to BLACK. Keep silver frame, shirt folds and stitching, tie and surface exact. Preserve every other visible detail pixel-consistently: exact camera, crop, geometry, positions, colors, textures, light and shadows. Do not introduce any other semantic difference. Same landscape 4:3 composition, no words, labels or new objects.

difficulty.basis: Editorial judgment only, not measured player calibration.
difficulty.note: Very small low-area color target; visible at140px on inspection and the hardest color target in this group.

items.question: ما التغيير الصغير في صورتي القطع المعدنية؟
items.observation: Only the reduced-size O-ring changes from red to black. Three silver nuts and the bolt retain their arrangement. Original A with an oversized ring was replaced before B generation.

a.actualPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct only the size of the red rubber O-ring in the supplied still-life. The red O-ring is too large; reduce its outer diameter to approximately HALF its current diameter, about 9 percent of the total image width. Keep its exact center at x=81%, y=33%, retain its round ring geometry and visible central hole, and scale its natural contact shadow accordingly. Preserve all three hex nuts, the silver bolt, thread detail, background, framing and every other visible detail exactly. Do not relocate the O-ring or add objects. This corrected version becomes image A of a difficult spot-the-difference pair. No text.

b.actualPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the EXACT first image of a spot-the-difference pair. Make ONE AND ONLY ONE intentional change: Recolor only the small RED rubber O-ring at x=81 y=33 to BLACK. Preserve its shape and inner hole, all three nuts, bolt, mat weave and shadows. Preserve every other visible detail pixel-consistently: exact camera, crop, geometry, positions, colors, textures, light and shadows. Do not introduce any other semantic difference. Same landscape 4:3 composition, no words, labels or new objects.

difficulty.basis: Editorial judgment only, not measured player calibration.
difficulty.note: Small isolated target; clearer than the cufflink despite same tier.

runtime.runtimeScope: Headless local Chrome, production source bundle and unchanged actual pack/media; eight isolated contexts and test-only deterministic per-tier deck selection. All questions traversed real category/board/reveal/hide flow at both widths. No production entitlement claim.
criteria: neutral filenames and generic numbered alt before reveal
answer and accepted aliases absent from visible text and image/title/aria/src before reveal
no marker or hidden-answer lightbox before reveal
two marker centers at physical left/top spot percentages with diameter 2r, contained in image bounds
hide removes both markers and answer
category,80media,App.js and styles.css hashes unchanged during runtime

manualVisualReview.method: All 30 final runtime contact sheets were actually viewed: every one of the 40 pairs before/after reveal at both 320px and 390px. Native stage images originate from the real application renderer. Representative complete question screens were also viewed. Contacts are resized display aids; original stage and full-page PNGs are retained.
manualVisualReview.semanticCriterion: Exactly one intended meaningful object/color/count/orientation/shape difference was identified per pair. Generated fine texture and lighting may drift; this is not a claim of pixel identity outside the target.
notes: Difficulty targets are editorial estimates, not measured success rates. Some high-tier color or count changes remain relatively conspicuous (especially spotdiff-800-902).
spotdiff-1000-903: the correct marker has modest contrast against the red ladybug shell. A future contrasting outline could improve visibility; no coordinate correction is required.
spotdiff-800-906 and spotdiff-1000-906/907 use small discernible targets at 390px; 320px stacked images are larger. These were inspected before reveal.
This tested renderer already contains the concurrently saved reveal App.js/styles.css fix. This spotdiff report does not certify reveal behavior.
Local synthetic account and entitlement fixture only; no paid production account, billing, deployment, or real service validation.

runtime.harnessPackaging: Runtime used the scratch harness. The portable copy differs only in repository/output path resolution and fileURLToPath import; syntax checked separately. Reruns default to a separate rerun/ directory.
runtime.supersededAttempt: initial-results-before-capture-fix.json passed928 automated checks but its 320px element screenshots could be scrolled underneath the sticky header by Playwright. Final harness centers the stage and asserts both images below the header. Current results and all current PNGs are the corrected full rerun,1089/1089. No app source was changed for this capture issue.
